Local Computation of Maximal Independent Set
Graph k-Coloring in Average Sublinear Time

upsertSlices.label: LCA; consistent list coloring with distinct query guarantees
upsertSlices.task: Answer the color of a requested vertex consistently with one proper global list-coloring
assumptions: General simple graph with indexed adjacency-neighbor and readable list input
List sizes and randomness are specified per result
A single fixed random tape is reused for randomized algorithms; deterministic result is stateless
Per-query probe costs; no total-output or cross-model lower bound is inferred

xAxis.label: Per-vertex probe formula; symbolic categories, not a universal cost ranking

results.bound: Δ^{O(1)} · O(log n) queries per vertex, with high probability
results.guarantee: Proper list coloring from lists of size at least Δ+1; common palette gives (Δ+1)-coloring
results.sourceLocation: Theorem 1.3; model in Section 1.3; implementation in Section 4.3
results.notes: The poly(Δ) symbol does not identify a numerical exponent. The matching symbolic class of the 2022 reduction is not a claim that its hidden polynomial is smaller.

results.bound: poly(Δ) · log n probes with high probability for all vertices; expected poly(Δ) probes for each fixed queried vertex
results.guarantee: Proper (degree+1)-list coloring; also solves (Δ+1)-list coloring by retaining degree(v)+1 allowed colors
results.notes: One source record has two displayed guarantees. It does not create a new independent paper or an extra result ID. The expected guarantee is not an all-query worst-case cost bound.

results.bound: Δ^{O(√Δ log^{5/2}Δ)} · log* n probes per vertex
results.guarantee: Deterministic proper list coloring from lists of size at least Δ+1
results.notes: For fixed Δ≥2, this specializes to O(log* n) probes. For variable Δ, the degree factor is much larger; the figure therefore uses symbolic categories, not a fabricated total order.

upsertSlices.label: Average-case exact k-coloring; reported LCA probes
upsertSlices.task: Answer requested vertex colors consistently with an exact k-coloring
assumptions: Uniform distribution over all labeled k-colorable graphs, not G(n,p) and not arbitrary worst-case graphs
A fixed shared random tape; zero-error allows FAIL

The local probe unit is unresolved: the proof charges O(ν) probes for a sampled core with ν=Θ(k^9 log k) vertices, while certifying its induced adjacency matrix would ordinarily need pair-entry accounting
The full-output Ω(nk) lower bound is not a lower bound for these local queries

xAxis.label: Exact palette target; separate average-case contract

yAxis.label: Source-reported local probe count; unresolved probe unit

results.bound: Theorem 10 reports O(k^9 log k) average-case probes and O(k^26 polylog k) average-case time
results.guarantee: Exact k-coloring under the uniform distribution over k-colorable labeled graphs; zero-error partial answers or FAIL
results.sourceLocation: Theorem 10, Appendix A.2; Definitions A.2–A.4 (arXiv v1 printed pp.37–40)
results.notes: Preserved as a related result with a visible source-audit qualification. The source theorem is verified in both HTML and PDF, but its O(k^9 log k) count is not placed on the main adjacency-list cost axis or advertised as an exact adjacency-matrix pair-probe bound.
